info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Ecommerce Cart Taxs-v5-spec
info.description: This API provides access to the tax details associated with ecommerce shopping carts. Implemented primarily for retail developers, it allows applications to retrieve tax information for items in the user's cart based on current tax regulations. Users can expect to access specific tax rates and calculations applicable to their cart contents. This functionality is essential for ensuring accurate pricing and compliance during the checkout process.

get.summary: Retrieve tax information for the cart.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current tax information applicable to the items in the cart. It calculates the applicable taxes based on the items in the cart and the location, providing a clear breakdown of tax amounts.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to calculate the tax for items in the cart. It requires specific information which will be provided in the JSON format to determine the applicable taxes based on the cart's contents.

200.description: Successfully retrieved tax information for the shopping cart.

ListEcommerceCartTaxsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to cart taxes. It is expected to be a JSON string.
